mapper.select:
SELECT PRODUCT_ID, PRODUCT_NM, PRODUCT_TYPE, UNIT_CD, UNIT_PRICE, USE_YN FROM TB_PRODUCT
USE_YN = 'Y'
AND PRODUCT_NM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{productNm}, '%')
AND PRODUCT_TYPE = #{productType}
ORDER BY PRODUCT_NM

SELECT IFNULL((SELECT PP.UNIT_PRICE FROM TB_PRODUCT_PRICE PP WHERE PP.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID AND #{baseDt} BETWEEN PP.APPLY_FROM_DT AND PP.APPLY_TO_DT ORDER BY PP.APPLY_FROM_DT DESC LIMIT 1), P.UNIT_PRICE) FROM TB_PRODUCT P WHERE P.PRODUCT_ID = #{productId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_PRODUCT (PRODUCT_ID, PRODUCT_NM, PRODUCT_TYPE, UNIT_CD, UNIT_PRICE, USE_YN, REG_DT) VALUES (#{productId}, #{productNm}, #{productType}, #{unitCd}, #{unitPrice}, 'Y', NOW())
INSERT INTO TB_PRODUCT_PRICE (PRODUCT_ID, CUST_GRADE, UNIT_PRICE, APPLY_FROM_DT, APPLY_TO_DT) VALUES (#{productId}, #{custGrade}, #{unitPrice}, #{applyFromDt}, #{applyToDt})
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_PRODUCT SET PRODUCT_NM = #{productNm}, PRODUCT_TYPE = #{productType}, UNIT_CD = #{unitCd}, UNIT_PRICE = #{unitPrice}, UPD_DT = NOW() WHERE PRODUCT_ID = #{productId}
